subject: Unbilled usage / ledger mismatch — request for audit and corrected invoice
messages:
From: Finance Team <finance@cloudretail.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@cloudretail.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Discrepancy on Aug invoice / missing marketplace payout

Hi Camila,

We're reviewing the August payout from AWS Marketplace and noticed the payout on the invoice (attached) is ~27% lower than expected based on our internal usage. Can Redwood confirm whether any unbilled events or withheld metering rows exist for our seller account (CloudRetail Seller ID: CR-99321)?

We ran a quick check on our side and see a gap of roughly $42,300 between our usage ledger and the marketplace settlement CSV. I attached the settlement PDF and our raw metering report for reference.

Specific asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood submitted all metering reports for August?
- If not, can we get a reconciliation and a corrected invoice/credit?
- We need an ETA on when this will be resolved; finance is holding the payout until it's clarified.

Thanks,
Sophia Lane
Senior Manager, Finance
CloudRetail Inc.
Attachments: cloudretail_202608-202609_invoice.pdf (pdf), cloudretail_raw_metering_export_2026-08-31.csv (csv)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Finance Team <finance@cloudretail.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Aug invoice / missing marketplace payout

Hi Sophia — thanks for flagging this and for the attachments. We're looking into it now.

Quick note on process so we're aligned: when marketplace meter events fail to map to the seller listing (usually due to a listing ID mismatch or truncated token in the metering payload), AWS/GCP sometimes withhold those rows from settlement. We haven't seen a systemic issue recently, but we'll:

- Pull our submitted metering exports for the CR-99321 seller id for Aug 1–31
- Reconcile against CloudRetail's CSV you provided
- Surface any missing/duplicate rows and propose a correction path (credit vs. resubmit)

Can you please confirm the preferred outcome for you: corrected invoice + credit note, or resubmission to the marketplace and updated settlement? We can support either but the time-to-resolution differs.

I'll own the recon and loop in Marissa (payments) for credits and Karthik (marketplace integrations) for the technical side. Expect a status update by end of day Wed.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Lead — Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Regards,
Sophia Lane

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Discrepancy on Aug invoice / missing marketplace payout

Looping up our findings after an initial pass against the metering logs. Key notes:

- We located ~3,200 meter events from Aug 10–Aug 12 that were submitted under a legacy listing token (listing_legacy_0x7) instead of the current seller listing (CR-99321_main). Those rows did not map in AWS settlement and therefore were excluded from the payout.
- There are 18 duplicate events (retries) that resulted in small overcounts in the ledger on CloudRetail's side; we'll drop those in the corrected calc.
- Net impact: the differential Sophia reported (~$42.3k) aligns to the unmapped legacy-listing events after removing duplicates.

Proposed remediation options (pros/cons):
1) Issue a Redwood credit note for $42,300 and a corrected invoice reflecting the adjusted payout.
   - Pros: fastest for CloudRetail AP to close.
   - Cons: bookkeeping on our end, but small and one-time.
2) Resubmit the missing metering rows to AWS under the correct listing and request a settlement adjustment.
   - Pros: preserves ledger continuity on marketplace level.
   - Cons: AWS settlement timelines are slower (2–6 weeks) and not guaranteed to speed payment.

Recommendation: Option 1 (credit note + corrected invoice). If CloudRetail prefers resubmission, we can do that but expect a longer timeline.

Action items:
- Camila to confirm preferred remediation (CloudRetail).
- Marissa to prepare draft credit note and corrected invoice (ETA Thu EOD).
- Karthik to prepare the resubmission package in case CloudRetail chooses that path.

Attachments: redwood_recon_notes_2026-09-15.xlsx (excel)

—Marissa
Director, Payments & Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sophia Lane <finance@cloudretail.com>

Hi Camila / Marissa — thanks for the diagnosis and the clear options. CloudRetail accepts Option 1: credit note + corrected invoice is preferred so we can close August.

Please proceed with the corrected invoice and a formal credit note for $42,300. Once we receive the paperwork, we will process the adjusted payout in our AP system. Can you also include a one-paragraph statement describing root cause (listing token mismatch) for our auditors?

If you can get the docs to contracts@cloudretail.com and finance@cloudretail.com by EOD Friday (2026-09-17), that would be ideal.

Regards,

- Internal follow-up: Karthik will run a backfill verify for Sep to ensure no further legacy tokens are present.
